Record Class BlockTransformer.BlockTransformData

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
net.minestom.server.instance.block.transformer.BlockTransformer.BlockTransformData
Record Components:
blockStateProvider - the provider of the state the block is turned into, by key or inline
sound - the sound played on use
particle - the particle effect played on use
disallowedFaces - the faces the block may not be used on
loot - the key of the loot table dropped by the transform, null to drop nothing
dropStrategy - where the drops appear
updateFromNeighbors - whether the placed block is updated by its neighbors
transformType - which block shape the transform applies to
consumeOnUse - whether the used item is consumed
itemDamagePerUse - how much durability the used item loses, must not be negative
Enclosing class:
BlockTransformer
public static record BlockTransformer.BlockTransformData(Holder<BlockStateProvider> blockStateProvider, SoundEvent sound, BlockTransformer.TransformParticle particle, List<Direction> disallowedFaces, @Nullable Key loot, BlockTransformer.DropStrategy dropStrategy, boolean updateFromNeighbors, BlockTransformer.TransformType transformType, boolean consumeOnUse, int itemDamagePerUse) extends Record
One transform an item may apply.
